caption:
First week back at work? Give your body the same once-over you give your inbox. Mr Turtle went from beach walks to desk mode overnight.

Five quick checks: set your screen at eye level with feet on the floor, stand or walk every 30 to 45 minutes, carry your bag on both shoulders, notice any holiday niggles that haven't settled after a couple of weeks, and book two or three exercise sessions into your calendar like meetings.

Physio, chiro, clinical Pilates and remedial massage sit under one roof at Hybrid Physio, so our team can help you find the right starting place. Book online via the link in bio 💼
